text:
Priya (CSM): Heads up — EBR next Tues 2pm PT. Need final slide owners for the deck + a short 2-min demo cue. Found 3 onboarding gaps in the health report that execs will ask about.
Ethan - CS Ops: On it. Can you paste the slide list? I'll assign and ping owners.
Priya (CSM): ```
1) Exec summary (Priya)
2) Onboarding health & gaps (owner?)
3) Renewal risk signal & mitigation plan (Ruth)
4) Demo: Live onboarding flow (owner?)
5) Q&A / next steps (all)
```
Marco (Solutions Eng): @Priya I can take demo owner but need 10-15 mins to prep. Do we want live or recorded?
Priya (CSM): Live preferred but fallback to recorded. Marco — can we scope demo to 'first 3mins show success path; 2 mins show failure case'?
Marco (Solutions Eng): Yes. Also need a test account with customer data subset — @Ruth can you confirm access?
Ruth (AM): I can grant a sandbox. Pinged infra to whitelist IP. ETA EOD today.
Ethan - CS Ops: I'll own slide 2 (Onboarding health & gaps). Will add top 3 metrics + incident timeline. Need the latest health board link.
Priya (CSM): Link: https://redwood.test/health/ACCT-772 — add the mini-heatmap and renewal flag.
cs-bot: Reminder: deck template version v3 is in /drive/ebr/v3 — auto-check will run 24hrs before meeting.
Marco (Solutions Eng): One ask — can someone capture enablement feedback bullets from customer interviews? I'll demo failure case and want top 2 asks.
Ruth (AM): I'll compile interview notes and surface top asks. Adding to the slide as bullet list.
Ethan - CS Ops: For renewal risk slide, include 'usage dip last 30 days' and 'billing dispute open' — noted.
Priya (CSM): Cool. Owner list so far: Exec summary (Priya), Onboarding health (Ethan), Renewal risk (Ruth), Demo (Marco). Can @Liam (Customer Success Dir) give 2-min exec intro?
Liam (Customer Success Dir): Yes — I'll do the intro and call out strategic ask. Send me 1-2 bullets to read.
Priya (CSM): Sending bullets by end of day.
Marco (Solutions Eng): :thumbsup: planning to rehearse Thu 10am PT — does that work?
Ethan - CS Ops: Works for me.
Ruth (AM): Works.
Priya (CSM): I'll schedule and invite execs + tech leads. Any blockers?
Marco (Solutions Eng): Need the sandbox creds before rehearsal.
Ruth (AM): I'll post creds in 1:1 secure channel and confirm once infra whitelists.
Priya (CSM): :eyes: I'll track action items and run a pre-EBR checklist 24hrs out. Adding action tracker: `A1: Deck finish (all)`, `A2: Demo creds (Ruth)`, `A3: Rehearsal (all)`, `A4: Exec bullets (Priya/Liam)`
cs-bot: Action tracker created: https://redwood.tasks/ACCT-772/ebr-actions — auto-reminders set.
Priya (CSM): Thanks team. If no other comments, closing thread here. Please react when your items are done.
